burst.skip: leading PWM periods off in each burst period
burst.update: at the start of each burst period (preloaded)

bridge.modulation: unipolar: leg A high side follows D, leg B high side follows 1-D (initInverterUnipolar)
bridge.duty_limits_source: driver default user limits of the inverter legs (hrtim.c duty_min_user/duty_max_user = 0.1/0.9, intersected by setInverterDutyCycle); a scenario may override them (shield setDutyCycleMin/Max, e.g. 0.05/0.95)
bridge.update_delay_source: assumption at the 50 µs control period (ADR 0006): sensors + control part of the critical task (about 30 µs, L0-TIM at 100 µs) plus up to one 20 µs carrier period before the preloaded compare takes effect; to re-measure

relay.feedback: as main.cpp: the command held for app::relay_contact_ticks (20 ms) is reported as the relay state; no contact sensing
